decisions.proposed_text: Thiếu nữ trong sáng × tuổi nổi loạn
decisions.reason: Current wording 'thuần tình' is unnatural Vietnamese; 'trong sáng' preserves 纯情 while keeping the stylized title structure.
Accurately and naturally renders 白银收藏家 as a silver collector title.
Preserves both the steadfast/tenacious nuance and the speed-master title sense without structural loss.
Poetic Vietnamese retains the 'no matter how many times the curtain rises' meaning and the 无论 condition.
Natural and semantically complete rendering of 温泉爱好者.
The current phrase clearly conveys a hot-spring-village adviser and is acceptable Vietnamese for this title context.

decisions.proposed_text: Khoảnh khắc hạnh phúc tột cùng
decisions.reason: 'Chí phúc' is stiff/opaque in Vietnamese; the revision naturally expresses 至福 (supreme bliss).

decisions.proposed_text: Người truy tìm truyền thuyết về suối nóng bí ẩn
decisions.reason: 'Bí tuyền' is unnatural/opaque Vietnamese; the revision makes 秘汤传说 explicit and natural without changing the seeker meaning.
Natural title rendering of 挖掘匠人 as a master of excavation/digging.
Concise Vietnamese preserves the image of vitality surging forth.
The current 'đã hẹn' construction is awkward as a title; 'ước hẹn' preserves 约定 naturally and compactly.
Natural and faithful rendering of 黄金之旅途 as a golden journey.
Generic 技能 is a gameplay label and the embedded community rule explicitly forbids 'Kỹ năng'.
decisions.terminology_basis: community term common.skill.generic requires preferred English label 'Skill' for generic 技能.

decisions.reason: Current text omits the required canonical proper name for 神业 while the rest of 之轨迹 is correctly represented by 'quỹ đạo'.
decisions.terminology_basis: locked term character.kiseki maps alias 神业 to canonical target 'Kiseki'.

decisions.proposed_text: Người thể hiện bản thân xuất sắc nhất
decisions.reason: 'Người trình diễn bản thân mạnh nhất' is unnatural Vietnamese; the revision preserves the superlative self-performance meaning.
Natural and faithful rendering of 无与伦比之瞳 as peerless/unmatched eyes.
Naturally preserves the image of footsteps leading toward a dream.
Direct and natural rendering of 梦想的结晶 with no structural loss.
Umazing! is a deliberate stylized expression; preserving it unchanged is appropriate rather than translating the wordplay.
Accurate and natural rendering of 六星的羁绊 as a six-star bond.
